title: A Record Said This Beetle Lifts 850 Times Its Weight. A Scientist Checked
subject: rhinoceros beetle

scenes.text: A famous record says this beetle carries 850 times its weight.
A scientist tested it. He glued weights to the beetles and put them on a treadmill.
The real limit was about a hundred times their weight, and at that load they barely moved.
At forty times, they walked about ten minutes before giving out.
At thirty times, they walked half an hour with no sign of tiring. The scientist got bored first.
That's like a person walking a mile with a car on their head. Not 850, but still absurd.

description:
A famous record claimed rhinoceros beetles carry 850 times their weight.
Physiologist Rodger Kram of UC Berkeley tested it: about 100 times at the very most, and 30 times for half an hour without tiring.
What's the strongest animal you can think of?
first_comment: What's the strongest animal for its size, in your opinion?
